description: Insert or update a record by key field. If a record with the matching key value exists, update it. If not, insert it. Batch supported via records array.

key.description: Field name to match on (must exist in format file)

record.description: JSON object of a single record. Must contain the key field. Use this OR records, not both.

records.description: JSON array of records for batch upsert. Each must contain the key field. Use this OR record, not both.

userid.description: Project owner's username. Required when accessing a shared project where you are a writer. Defaults to the authenticated user.

name: chaprola_upsert_record
